correctness.rationale: For a uniform bridge of 2n steps n>=2, exchangeability gives expected internal up/down adjacent peaks n/2. Under any k specified strictly interior even-time zero pins, the blocks are independent uniform bridges whose peaks contribute n/2 and their k joins contribute k/4, proving the location-free pinning identity. Expanding z^R across all pin subsets yields E[P z^R]=(n/2)G(z)+(z−1)G'(z)/4. Signed first-return excursions have generating function 1−sqrt(1−4t), with exactly r+1 excursions when R=r; Lagrange inversion yields q_r ratio 2(r+2)(n−r−1)/(2n−r−2). Coefficient comparison gives E[P|R=r]=(n−1)/2+r(r+2)/[4(2n−r−2)]. Its continuous extension has positive first and second derivative across 0..n−1, with n=2 endpoint checked directly; covariance = (4^n/binom(2n,n)−2)/4 follows from pinning and central binomial convolution. Independently enumerated 4704 balanced paths across small n and checked conditioning; original script separately checks broader sizes. No enumerative finite range is substituted for proof.
